name: Gradient Descent Registration via ZNCC
definition: A registration technique minimizing the negative Zero-Normalized Cross-Correlation (ZNCC) between a fixed DRR (ground truth) and a moving DRR (initialized randomly) using gradient descent on the 6 DoF parameters.
summary: Gradient Descent Registration via ZNCC is a local refinement method that optimizes 6 DoF pose by minimizing negative Zero-Normalized Cross-Correlation using gradient descent with momentum.
